frames.credit: Visualizations courtesy of NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio (SVS) and the NASA Earth Information Center.
frames.relation: Shows where the ocean is warmer or cooler than usual, the same idea as the harmony layer. It covers recent days worldwide, not the years in the sound.
